name: Muted words
description: Hides messages that contain words you choose, on this device, with one click to see each one. It reads messages to find them, keeps nothing of them, and contacts no one.

settings.label: Words
settings.hint: Separated by commas. A message with any of them, as a whole word, in any case, is hidden.

settings.label: Hide them
settings.hint: Off, a message with one is only marked.
